  "description": "Fhemfel Group is a multifaceted company specializing in real estate, travel, and hospitality. We are dedicated to creating exceptional experiences and spaces that cater to the diverse needs of our clients. With a team of experts in each sector, we focus on delivering innovative solutions that combine luxury, comfort, and sustainability. Our commitment to quality and customer satisfaction drives us to excel in every project we undertake, making us a trusted partner in the industries we serve.

We are&nbsp;recruiting to fill the position below:

&nbsp;Job Position: Graphic Designer

Job Location: Abuja (FCT)
Employment Type: Full-time

Job description


	We are looking for a creative, detail-oriented, and highly motivated Graphic Designer to join our team at Fhemfel Group. In this role, you will play a key part in shaping the visual identity of our brand and supporting marketing, product, and communication teams with high-quality design assets.
	You must have a strong design portfolio, a passion for storytelling through visuals, and the ability to translate ideas into impactful graphics


Key Responsibilities
Brand Design &amp; Identity:


	Develop and maintain consistent visual branding across all design assets.
	Create logos, icons, illustrations, and visual identity materials.
	Ensure all content aligns with the company&rsquo;s brand standards and tone.


Digital Media &amp; Content Creation:


	Design social media graphics, digital ads, banners, and email templates.
	Support website and blog design with custom visuals and infographics.
	Collaborate with the digital marketing team to support campaigns and promotions.


Print Design &amp; Production:


	Create flyers, brochures, business cards, event materials, and packaging.
	Work with external vendors to manage print production processes.


Visual Storytelling &amp; Campaign Support:


	Turn complex information into compelling visual content.
	Assist with storytelling through branded visuals and presentation decks.
	Develop visuals for marketing campaigns, events, and product launches.


Creative Collaboration &amp; Workflow Management:


	Work closely with marketing, content, and other internal teams to understand creative needs.
	Manage multiple projects while adhering to timelines and feedback.
	Participate in creative brainstorming sessions.


Trend Research &amp; Innovation:


	Stay informed on current trends in design, branding, and technology.
	Introduce fresh design ideas and tools to elevate the brand&rsquo;s creative direction.


Qualifications &amp; Skills


	At least 4 years of relevant experience with a strong portfolio.
	Proficient in Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Coreldraw, Illustrator, InDesign, After Effects is a plus).
	Understanding of typography, color theory, layout, and visual hierarchy.
	Familiarity with Canva, Figma, or other modern design tools.
	Excellent attention to detail, creativity, and problem-solving skills.
	Ability to work both independently and collaboratively.
	Basic knowledge of motion graphics or video editing is an advantage.


Method of Application&nbsp;
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: fhemfelgrouphr@gmail.com using the Job Position as the subject of the mail.",

        Fhemfel Group is a multifaceted company specializing in real estate, travel, and hospitality. We are dedicated to creating exceptional experiences and spaces that cater to the diverse needs of our clients. With a team of experts in each sector, we focus on delivering innovative solutions that combine luxury, comfort, and sustainability. Our commitment to quality and customer satisfaction drives us to excel in every project we undertake, making us a trusted partner in the industries we serve.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Graphic Designer

Job Location: Abuja (FCT)
Employment Type: Full-time

Job description
     

            
    




	We are looking for a creative, detail-oriented, and highly motivated Graphic Designer to join our team at Fhemfel Group. In this role, you will play a key part in shaping the visual identity of our brand and supporting marketing, product, and communication teams with high-quality design assets.
	You must have a strong design portfolio, a passion for storytelling through visuals, and the ability to translate ideas into impactful graphics


Key Responsibilities
Brand Design & Identity:


	Develop and maintain consistent visual branding across all design assets.
	Create logos, icons, illustrations, and visual identity materials.
	Ensure all content aligns with the company’s brand standards and tone.


Digital Media & Content Creation:


	Design social media graphics, digital ads, banners, and email templates.
	Support website and blog design with custom visuals and infographics.
	Collaborate with the digital marketing team to support campaigns and promotions.


Print Design & Production:


	Create flyers, brochures, business cards, event materials, and packaging.
	Work with external vendors to manage print production processes.


Visual Storytelling & Campaign Support:


	Turn complex information into compelling visual content.
	Assist with storytelling through branded visuals and presentation decks.
	Develop visuals for marketing campaigns, events, and product launches.


Creative Collaboration & Workflow Management:


	Work closely with marketing, content, and other internal teams to understand creative needs.
	Manage multiple projects while adhering to timelines and feedback.
	Participate in creative brainstorming sessions.


Trend Research & Innovation:


	Stay informed on current trends in design, branding, and technology.
	Introduce fresh design ideas and tools to elevate the brand’s creative direction.


Qualifications & Skills


	At least 4 years of relevant experience with a strong portfolio.
	Proficient in Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Coreldraw, Illustrator, InDesign, After Effects is a plus).
	Understanding of typography, color theory, layout, and visual hierarchy.
	Familiarity with Canva, Figma, or other modern design tools.
	Excellent attention to detail, creativity, and problem-solving skills.
	Ability to work both independently and collaboratively.
	Basic knowledge of motion graphics or video editing is an advantage.


Method of Application

Quality Assurance Officer Job at Pullus




        
    

        
        Pullus is leveraging on data-driven technology to connect poultry farmers to affordable finance, better markets, advisory services, global best practices and quality inputs

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Quality Assurance Officer

Job Location: Abuja (FCT) & Kaduna
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary
     

            
    




	As the Quality Assurance Officer at Pullus Africa, your primary responsibility will be to ensure the consistent production of high-quality, safe poultry products.
	This role will oversee all quality control measures throughout the poultry production process, from converting the raw materials to final product packaging and distribution.
	The Quality Assurance officer will work closely with the purchase, extension, and logistics teams to uphold rigorous quality standards and drive continuous improvement.


Responsibilities


	Develop, implement, and maintain comprehensive quality assurance programs, including quality control procedures, inspections, and audits.
	Monitor production processes to identify and resolve quality issues in a timely manner.
	Conduct regular testing and analysis of raw materials, work-in-process, and finished poultry products to verify compliance with food safety regulations and internal quality specifications.
	Document quality control activities and maintain detailed records to demonstrate process control.
	Carry out research and development exercises to evaluate new technologies, equipment, and processes that can enhance product quality and operational efficiency.
	Train and supervise staff to ensure adherence to standard operating procedures.
	Serve as the primary point of contact for all quality-related inquiries from internal and external stakeholders.
	Stay up-to-date with relevant industry regulations, standards, and best practices in poultry production.


Qualifications


	Bachelor’s degree in food science, food technology, or a related field.
	3 - 5 years of experience in a quality assurance or quality control role within the poultry or food processing industry.
	Thorough understanding of HACCP, GMP, ISO and food safety standards.
	Proficiency in data analysis and the use of quality control software.
	Excellent documentation, auditing and reporting skills.
	Resides in Kaduna or Abuja(Karu or its environs).


Note: Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

Cash & Stock Officer (Agbani Service Station) Job at Pinnacle




        
    

        
        Pinnacle is an Indigenous Oil and Gas Company active across the entire downstream value chain, with emphasis on the petroleum trading, marketing, distribution and retail segments of the Nigerian Oil and Gas Sector.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Cash & Stock Officer (Agbani Service Station)

Job Location: Agbani, Enugu

Job Description
     

            
    




	Monitor and record daily stock levels of lubricants in warehouse.
	Responsible for receiving and verify product deliveries against waybills, loading documents and purchase orders, ensuring quantities and quality meet specification before acceptance
	Ensure proper documentation of all stock movements including transfers, returns and adjustments.
	Responsible for collecting, counting, recording, and banking and safe keeping of all daily cash sales of the station.
	Preparation of daily/monthly POS reconciliation report to ensure accuracy of receipt of funds.
	Prepare and submit accurate daily, weekly and monthly stock reports to the finance team.
	Responsible for identifying and promptly report stock discrepancies, variances, losses or suspected theft to the Station Manager.
	Any other tasks may be assigned from time to time.


Requirements


	B.Sc / HND Degree
	Experience in similar or related role of 2 - 3 years
	Attention to details
	Clear and accurate written and spoken communication
	Ability to work with and in teams' settings
	Self-motivated and work well with little supervision.


Method of Application
Interested and qualified candidates should forward their CV to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the email.
